lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered matrix of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns. A primary alignment of four high-intensity centroids is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming the leading edge of a repeating grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of luminance maxima. These intersections create localized anchor nodes of peak brightness, most prominent in the central region between the primary longitudinal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and localized shadowing on the ventral-facing edge, oriented parallel to the longitudinal body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (family Echeneidae) is visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface below the trailing edge of the pectoral fin, appearing as a dark, elongated silhouette.
